message.content:
```bash
for f in *.jpeg; do mv -- "$f" "${f%.jpeg}.jpg"; done
```

This loops over each `.jpeg` file and renames it by stripping the `.jpeg` extension and appending `.jpg`. The quoting handles filenames with spaces.

If no `.jpeg` files exist, the loop will try to run once on the literal string `*.jpeg` and error out harmlessly. To avoid that, you can enable nullglob first:

```bash
shopt -s nullglob; for f in *.jpeg; do mv -- "$f" "${f%.jpeg}.jpg"; done
```
